title: onPageOpenedRememberPageInSpace
description: Hears Page opened and runs Remember the page in its space when the page belongs to a space.

title: onPageOpenedMoveActiveTab
description: Hears Page opened at an address the tab set did not set itself and moves the active tab there (Move in the active tab), or steps it on Back and Forward.

title: onActiveTabChangedMoveAddress
description: Hears Active tab changed and opens the active tab's address, giving the window that tab's history through the Browser history adapter.

title: noteSpacesListed
description: Once the nav has the products, it runs Note how many spaces there are with whether there are several.

title: openNavBranch
description: Before paint, on the nav's first draw and after a move made in the nav, it runs Open the nav's branch to the page.

title: decide
description: Decides, for a page opened as a stage switched in place, that the active tab's entry takes the address, and runs Change the active tab's address in place.

title: rememberStage
description: Hears Page opened on a stage, not on a narrow screen, and runs Remember the stage.

title: keepCamera
description: As a place is left, it runs Keep a place's camera with the camera and what it framed.

title: markProductLookedAt
description: Hears Page opened in another space, and runs Mark a product looked at with the moment.

title: onWindowOpenedStartAppServer
description: Hears Product window opened and runs Start a window's app server for it.

title: onWindowClosedStopAppServer
description: Hears Product window closed and runs Stop a window's app server for it; quitting runs that command for each window and waits for every stop.

title: onWindowOpenedAddRecentFolder
description: Hears Product window opened and runs Add a recent folder, then adds the folder to the system's recent documents and rebuilds the menu.

title: onWindowClosedEndChat
description: Hears Product window closed and runs End a window's chat for it; quitting runs that command for each window and waits for every stop.

title: menuBindings
description: In the desktop app the keymap reads the key bindings again after each save, and an effect on the resolved commands sends the window its menu keys (setMenuKeys, from menuBindings), which runs Report a window's keys.

title: useDesktopChrome
description: Sends the shown theme's chrome to the window, which runs Set a window's chrome.

title: useDesktopErrorCount
description: Sends the space's check errors to the window after each read, which runs Report a window's error count.
